questions: Should the co-occurrence matrix be built from the filtered words (after deduplication and stopword removal) as a single document, or should it consider sliding windows of n-grams across the original text?
What should happen if the filtered text contains fewer than n words? Should it return an empty matrix or handle it differently?
Is the n parameter intended to specify the n-gram size for the co-occurrence matrix (i.e., counting co-occurrences of n-grams) or something else?
Should the matrix diagonal be set to zero (ignoring self-co-occurrence) as in the reference, or is that an implementation detail not specified?
Should the function always use English stopwords from nltk.corpus, or should it allow customization (e.g., different languages or additional words)?
Are words compared in a case-sensitive manner during duplicate removal and stopword filtering?
Should punctuation be removed or handled in any way before processing?
Is the plot required to have specific visual properties (e.g., colormap 'hot', colorbar, rotated labels) as in the reference, or is any valid matplotlib plot acceptable?
